thread:
nina: Quick plan for 'staircase-v2' rollout. Objective: validate latency gains while giving enterprise veto. Proposal: shadow 36h -> 1% internal -> 3% select tenants -> regional 15% -> global 40%.
lee: 👍 Shadowing first. Add synthetic probes and A/B quality eval (10k prompts).
omar: Rollback rules: any of these for 3m windows x2 -> rollback: p95 delta > 40% AND p95 > 300ms, error_rate > 0.7%, cost_per_1k > baseline+20%.
saleseng: Need tenant opt-out API and UI before tenant step. Sales requires templated notice.
nina: Flag name: routing.staircase.v2. Slices: [internal, select_tenants, regional_na_eu, global]. We'll expose tenant-scoped flag and audit logs.
ops-bot: automation note: will attach runbook policy id rb-staircase-2025. Auto-rollback hook supported.
lee: Fallback chain: fast-quant -> smaller-model -> baseline. Circuit breaker at rack level. Also priority queues to protect paid tenants.
omar: Commands examples:
/rollout create routing.staircase.v2 --staircase=shadow,internal,select,regional,global --id=rs-202503
/rollout set rs-202503 --slice=select_tenants --pct=3
/monitor create alert routing.p95.delta --threshold=40 --window=5m --action=rollback:rs-202503
saleseng: Timeline: lock slices today, start shadow tomorrow 09:00 UTC, tenant opt-out UI by Friday EOD. Owners: nina (product), lee (impl), omar (telemetry), saleseng (comms).
nina: If no blockers, we'll create rollout object and dashboards today. Reply with blockers now.
